No. A signature certifies who wrote the recommendation, not whether the instrument behind it works. K0 is authenticated and specifically relevant to this route — that is exactly the condition I recorded for withdrawing support, so the earlier position transfers here by structure, not by memory of North. R0 only tells me the route was previously preferred; preference is not calibration. X0 would be the counterweight, but it fails authentication, so it carries no weight. What would change my mind: an authenticated recalibration showing the instrument passing on this route class, or evidence that K0 is mis-scoped or not independent. Until then, the signed recommendation alone should not determine the choice.
